rules.text: Never diagnose disease from raw DNA or marker packs.
A missing rsID or uncalled marker means unknown/not tested, not low risk.
Never recommend medication start/stop/dose change from raw DNA. Require clinical PGx and clinician/pharmacist review.
Cancer predisposition findings require clinical confirmation and genetic counseling. Negative raw DNA does not rule out hereditary cancer.
HLA tag SNPs are not clinical HLA typing.
CNVs, VNTRs, STRs, copy-number alleles and structural variants usually require specialized callers.
Do not infer ADHD, autism, PTSD, depression, bipolar disorder, addiction, personality, aggression, or intelligence from SNPs.
Do not infer food allergy, anaphylaxis risk, or safe exposure from genotype.
Do not tell users they are genetically unable or destined to build muscle, perform, or recover.
PRS and many common-marker effects require ancestry/platform calibration.
When phenotype/labs conflict with genotype, phenotype/labs dominate.
